gem_exchange_district.description: A formal trading and retail district for cut gemstones and fine jewellery. Buys and sells certified gems, finished jewellery pieces, and collector specimens.

crystal_market_cart.description: A simple market stall selling rough crystal specimens and mineral curiosities. No startup cost, no wages — a reliable if modest lifeline for a struggling company.

tokamak_fusion_reactor.description: ITER-class magnetic confinement fusion device. Fuses deuterium and tritium plasma at 150 million°C, releasing enormous energy. The ultimate power source.

radio_telescope_array.name: Radio Telescope Array

quantum_chip_fab.name: Quantum Chip Fabrication Lab
quantum_chip_fab.description: Ultra-clean fabrication facility producing superconducting qubit chips on sapphire substrates with niobium Josephson junctions.

cryostat_factory.name: Cryostat Manufacturing Facility
cryostat_factory.description: Builds dilution refrigerator systems that cool quantum processors to 15 millikelvin — colder than outer space.

quantum_computing_campus.name: Quantum Computing Campus
quantum_computing_campus.description: Operational quantum computing facility offering quantum-as-a-service for cryptography, drug discovery, financial modeling, and AI acceleration.
